name: Tiger Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Ajeck Rouack sends you after a tiger his hunters have tracked for weeks. Sin'Dall waits in northern Stranglethorn Vale, and her paw will prove the hunt is done.

sections.title: The Final Tiger
sections.body: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Ajeck Rouack sends you on one last hunt after your earlier trials against Stranglethorn's tigers. His hunters have tracked Sin'Dall through the jungle for weeks. Find the elusive tiger, kill her, and bring back her paw as proof.

sections.title: Master Tiger Hunter
sections.body: When you return to Nesingwary's camp with Sin'Dall's paw, Ajeck Rouack recognizes your skill at tracking. He names you a true Master Tiger Hunter.

faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack, a seasoned huntsman at Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, offers you this final hunt.
Sin'Dall is an elusive tiger pursued through the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale by the hunters of Nesingwary's Expedition for weeks.

faq.q: What proof does Ajeck Rouack require?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack asks you to return with Sin'Dall's paw as proof that you bested the tiger.
This hunt is the fourth and final step in Ajeck Rouack's series. It follows the third Tiger Mastery trial in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
